sections.title: CONCLUSION
sections.text_preview: This paper shows how to merge an LNA with quadrature mixers to lower noise and improve linearity at low power consumption. The resulting circuit can be thought of as a low-noise mixer with matched input impedance. In particular, the matter of LO leakage to the front-end is discussed in detail.
